listing.name: Long War
listing.summary: Adjusts the game's progression by doubling ship costs and enemy ship recovery chances.
listing.aiSummary: Adjusts the game's progression by doubling ship costs and enemy ship recovery chances.

description:
Long War

Adjusts the game's progression in a number of ways.

Ships cost twice as much, but the chance to recover enemy ships is doubled.

Commodities are at half value, but bounties pay better.

You only get two story points per level, but you level up much faster.

Passive income from commissions are cut by 90%, but they pay much better for fighting faction enemies.

You don't start with SO unlocked, but you do start with insulated engines and high-resolution sensors.

You get 0% bonus xp from avoiding battle with "special maneuvers," but get more bonus xp from many other sources.

Officers are easier to find and level up.

It's much easier to earn a "clean disengage" from combat.

Download HERE
